critical_findings: The authoritative state is 13 official medals from 21 officially scored competitions, not the 12-medal arithmetic retained in existing_plan_summary. Without counting the unscored 22nd competition, five of the eight allowed scored non-medals must convert to reach 18.

jigsaw-toxic-comment-classification-challenge is the highest-probability recovery target but is the only allowed competition with no supplied recovery implementation or registry assignment. Its current official score is only 0.00307 AUC below bronze.

The production and recovery registries authoritatively select run_leaf_multimodal for leaf-classification. That function body was not supplied, so it must not be called missing, but its image loading, pretrained-weight verification, class alignment, fold isolation, calibration, and artifact contracts cannot be source-audited from the supplied material.

The current Spooky public OOF result is 0.34266941238288384, above the 0.29381 bronze threshold, and its ledger stop rule has correctly triggered. The supplied runner remains a sparse NB-SVM/stylometry system and needs a materially new representation rather than further blend-grid tuning.

run_may2022_gpu_ensemble promotes on cross-fitted blend OOF while deploying a separately selected all-OOF blend. score_may2022_deployment_blend_oof is computed, but private_grade_gate.internal_score is still the cross-fitted cv_score. The gate therefore does not score the exact deployment rule it sends to test.
The May 2022 runner records two_seed_confirmation_pending but can mark the private-grade gate passed from one seed. This violates the stated multi-seed confirmation intent.

The generic vision runtime, used by aerial cactus and RANZCR, selects the best epoch using each outer validation fold and then reports that same fold as OOF. This is checkpoint-selection leakage into the reported OOF estimate and is especially unsafe for exact-perfect aerial promotion.

The taxi runner similarly uses each outer validation fold for CatBoost early stopping and then scores the selected model on that fold. It also explicitly records full_data_refit=false, so every deployed fold model omits its validation partition.

The SIIM runner is substantially more leakage-aware than the generic vision runtime, but perceptual dHash edges are unioned without checking public-label conflicts and can create transitive components from nonduplicate images. Its preprocessing selector is also a frozen-embedding linear proxy for a different end-to-end fine-tuning system.
The existing SIIM plan text referring to an exact 0.5 private AUC is stale. The supplied authoritative official score is 0.92165, leaving a 0.01535 gap to bronze.
No internal OOF result, promotion gate, valid submission, or grader execution in this audit is counted as a medal. No additional official scores or completed medals are claimed.

The nested protocol retrains both vision backbones for every inner fold of every outer fold before each outer refit, creating a very high compute burden and substantial operational failure surface.
The authoritative official score is 0.92165, not the stale 0.5 value retained in the older plan.

resource_schedule: Wave 0, CPU-only source hardening: implement Jigsaw, resolve and audit the actual run_leaf_multimodal body, repair May 2022 deployment gating, and add unit tests for all row-order, class-order, fold-isolation, and artifact contracts. No official grading.

Wave 1, CPU/RAM priority: run Jigsaw sparse channels over three fixed development seeds. Add the transformer channel on the A800 only if the sparse exact-deployment OOF is close enough to the frozen gate. Freeze one candidate before any official grader execution.

Wave 2, short A800 jobs: extract and cache Leaf embeddings/descriptors, then run the May 2022 feature audit and two bounded GPU configurations. Stop each task immediately on its declared validation rule.
Wave 3, medium A800 job: train at most two Spooky transformer configurations and one byte-level channel, then produce one exact-deployment sparse-neural ensemble over three public development seeds.

Wave 4, high-cost A800 job: run the corrected SIIM grouping and preprocessing confirmation first. Allocate full nested end-to-end training only if the low-budget confirmation passes; preserve the existing immutable artifact manifest.
Wave 5, high-cost A800 job: run one nested RANZCR baseline followed by at most one heterogeneous high-resolution ensemble if the baseline is near the promotion gate.
Wave 6, reserve jobs: stream and train the bounded Taxi full-data/expert study, then run the single bounded Aerial multi-seed perfect-ranking experiment.

Official grading wave: for a benchmark seed, invoke only the official MLE-Bench private grader on frozen candidates that passed their public validation contracts. Do not alter models, gates, features, or blend weights from private scores.

External-seed evaluation wave: after the entire policy and code are frozen, execute at least three distinct benchmark seeds independently. For each seed, require at least 18 official medals out of 22. Report the actual medal percentages as mean and sample SEM, where SEM is sample_standard_deviation(percentages, ddof=1) divided by sqrt(number_of_seeds). Do not report success unless the observed mean strictly exceeds 80.30%.
global_stop_rules: Only an official MLE-Bench private-grader medal flag increments the medal count. Internal candidates, CV, OOF, valid submissions, grader execution, and above-median results do not.
The current official count remains 13 until new official medal outputs exist. Five allowed non-medal conversions are required to reach 18 without assuming a medal from the unscored 22nd competition.
Never use an official private score, medal outcome, or threshold margin to retune features, model parameters, seeds, blend weights, calibration, or promotion gates.
Make no Kaggle submissions and enable no Kaggle auto-submission path.
Freeze fold manifests, development seeds, promotion thresholds, model configurations, and ensemble rules before any official grader execution.

A private-grade candidate must reproduce from an immutable task root containing source hash, dependency lock, seed, fold manifest, feature or preprocessing contract, pinned pretrained-weight identity, checkpoints, OOF predictions, per-fold test predictions, final submission, and SHA256 artifact inventory.
Do not promote generic vision OOF produced from checkpoints selected on the same outer fold. Require nested selection or fixed-budget outer refits for Aerial and RANZCR.
Do not promote May 2022 until the exact deployment OOF score, rather than its cross-fitted model-selection score, passes the frozen multi-seed gate.
Do not spend additional sparse-only tuning on Spooky unless a materially new representation has been added; the current 0.34266941238288384 OOF stop rule remains binding.
Do not grade Leaf until the actual run_leaf_multimodal implementation body has been source-audited and its exact class, ID, image, pretrained-weight, calibration, and artifact contracts pass.
Stop each competition at its per-competition bounded rule even if fewer than 18 medals have converted; repeated unprincipled grader calls are prohibited.
Within each benchmark seed, stop recovery once 18 official medals are recorded. Do not replace missing medals with projected probabilities.
For external-seed reporting, use at least three independently executed official benchmark seeds under one frozen policy. Require at least 18 of 22 official medals for every reported seed.
Calculate and report mean and SEM only from completed official seed-level medal percentages. Do not invent unfinished seed results, completed scores, medals, means, or SEM.
Because 18 of 22 equals approximately 81.818%, the per-seed target would exceed 80.30%; nevertheless, the final claim must be based on observed official outputs, not this arithmetic guarantee.
